title: Immutable historical data and controlled M005 reconstruction
objective: Build the governed historical-data and fixed-M005 reconstruction layer without opening the reserved final test, tuning parameters, or claiming profitability.
success_criteria: Missing historical data remains an explicit blocking state rather than being fabricated
Execution-grade snapshots require immutable SHA-256 identity plus bid and ask
Fixed M005 behaviour cannot drift or acquire search authority
Reserved final-test contents cannot be scored or used for selection before a separate human gate
stop_conditions: Any change outside rnd/ or to frozen/operational paths
Any inspection or scoring of reserved final-test strategy results
Any parameter optimization, strategy ranking or discovery
Any broker order capability, capital authority, automatic promotion or automatic merge
